import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('sales_data.xlsx')
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("First 10 rows:")
print(df.head(10).to_string())
print("\nDtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\nSheet: {name}  dims: {ws.dimensions}  max_row: {ws.max_row}  max_col: {ws.max_column}")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 15), values_only=True):
        print(row)

import importlib, sys, os, zipfile, re

print("Python:", sys.version)
for mod in ["pandas", "openpyxl", "xlrd", "xlsxwriter", "numpy"]:
    try:
        importlib.import_module(mod)
        print(mod, "AVAILABLE")
    except Exception as e:
        print(mod, "MISSING:", e)

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("sales_data.xlsx exists:", os.path.exists("sales_data.xlsx"))

if os.path.exists("sales_data.xlsx"):
    print("Size:", os.path.getsize("sales_data.xlsx"))
    try:
        z = zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx")
        print("Archive entries:")
        for n in z.namelist():
            print(" ", n)
        with z.open("xl/sharedStrings.xml") as f:
            content = f.read().decode("utf-8")
        print("sharedStrings length:", len(content))
        texts = re.findall(r"<t[^>]*>([^<]*)</t>", content)
        print("Shared strings sample:", texts[:40])
    except Exception as e:
        print("zip inspect error:", e)

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx")
for name in ["xl/styles.xml", "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml", "xl/workbook.xml", "docProps/app.xml"]:
    content = z.read(name).decode("utf-8")
    print("=" * 30, name, "=" * 30)
    print(content[:4000])
    print()

import zipfile, os, shutil

SRC = "sales_data.xlsx"
TMP = "sales_data_tmp.xlsx"

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = {name: z.read(name) for name in z.namelist()}
z.close()

sheet = entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"].decode("utf-8")
styles = entries["xl/styles.xml"].decode("utf-8")

def rep(s, old, new, label):
    assert s.count(old) == 1, f"{label}: expected 1 occurrence, found {s.count(old)}"
    return s.replace(old, new)

# --- sheet1.xml: dimension ---
sheet = rep(sheet, '<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>', "dimension")

# --- sheet1.xml: column widths ---
sheet = rep(
    sheet,
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>',
    "cols",
)

# --- sheet1.xml: header H1 ---
hdr_old = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
hdr_new = hdr_old[:-6] + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c></row>'
sheet = rep(sheet, hdr_old, hdr_new, "header H1")

# --- sheet1.xml: data rows 2-9 ---
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old[:-6] + f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    sheet = rep(sheet, old, new, f"row {r}")

# --- sheet1.xml: total row 10 ---
old10 = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new10 = old10[:-6] + '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>'
sheet = rep(sheet, old10, new10, "row 10")

# --- styles.xml: add percentage numFmt ---
styles = rep(
    styles,
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>',
    "numFmts",
)

# --- styles.xml: add two cell styles (percent, bold percent) ---
styles = rep(styles, '<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">', "cellXfs count")
new_xfs = (
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
)
styles = rep(styles, "</cellXfs><cellStyles", new_xfs + "</cellXfs><cellStyles", "cellXfs insert")

entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"] = sheet.encode("utf-8")
entries["xl/styles.xml"] = styles.encode("utf-8")

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name in entries:
        zout.writestr(name, entries[name])

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print("OK: sales_data.xlsx updated")
